news.title: Yatra Online Ltd Announces Chief Executive Officer Changes
news.body: Yatra Online Ltd. has elevated co-founder Dhruv Shringi, chief executive officer since inception, to the position of executive chairman. The company also announced the appointment of Siddhartha Gupta as its new CEO effective November 25, 2025. The leadership transition will "power its next phase of growth. Gupta has over 25 years of experience in enterprise technology and B2B SaaS and his leadership track record includes senior roles at SAP, HP, and high-growth SaaS ventures in India and overseas.
